parts.question: Compare adverse-event evidence in hn-204 and HN-402 for nausea

result.answer: For nausea, HN-204 reported 12.7% for AX-17 and 6.0% for control [E1] [E3], which was not serious [E1]. HN-402 reported 14.1% for AX-17 and 6.0% for control [E2] [E3], which was not serious [E2]. The treatment percentage difference (HN-402 minus HN-204) is +1.4 points and the control percentage difference is +0.0 points [E4].
